watch.summary: The streamer reacts with intense stress and shock as a Valorant pro player scores a game-changing double kill.

beats.what: Streamer sits stressed with hands on his head watching a close pro Valorant round.
Streamer narrates the play as team pushes onto site.
The defending pro player lands a sudden, rapid double kill.
Streamer screams out in total shock at the sudden double kill.
Streamer grabs his head again in disbelief as the round ends.

watch.author: pro_player_in_footage
watch.why: This clip relies on esports hype and sudden gameplay tension rather than comedy. The streamer's loud shock reaction reflects the intense round outcome, appealing more to fans of the game.
